verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a REST API and a published OpenAPI spec that go beyond inference to manage models, deployments, datasets, accounts and training, plus programmatic model upload and firectl-driven deployment and autoscaling. Nothing in the evidence confirms full parity with the web UI, so the API's breadth is shown but parity is unproven. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of the guided training flow and billing controls (auto reload, spend limits), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It also lets you automate management of models, deployments, datasets, and more.
